summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board minutes acknowledging the resignation of Board member Nitin Prabhu effective July 28, 2026, and approving a call for an Extraordinary General Meeting on August 18, 2026, to fix board size and elect two new members. The resignation appears voluntary; no reason or coercion is cited. No deal terms, premium, or advisor named. The filing is a routine governance update that maps to a US equivalent of a director resignation and meeting notice. What to watch: whether the meeting agenda signals broader governance shifts or merely routine succession.
